sources.title: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa: Get Information / Do I need visa?
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The live evisa.e-gov.kg service states that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs launched the Kyrgyz eVisa portal and provides its nationality/document eligibility selector.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Hong Kong and Macao permanent residents have a 30-day visa-free regime; Maldives citizens also have a 30-day regime.

sources.title: Kyrgyz Republic eVisa official portal and visa information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official eVisa portal identifies the Kyrgyz Ministry of Foreign Affairs as the service operator.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Electronic visa grants the same right to enter Kyrgyzstan as an ordinary sticker visa.

sources.title: Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 855: stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons
sources.publisher: Cabinet of Ministers of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Resolution No. 855 is published on the official gov.kg Cabinet of Ministers legal-acts portal and took effect upon official publication.
sources.supportingExcerpt: EAEU citizens may stay 90 days in 180; Uzbekistan 60 in 120; six Gulf states 180 in 360.

sources.title: Kyrgyz Export: current visa-free regime list
sources.publisher: Export Promotion and Investment Agency of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The current export.gov.kg page is an official Kyrgyz government service and expressly says its list reflects the latest legislative amendments.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of 71 countries have the opportunity to visit Kyrgyzstan without obtaining a visa.

policies.title: EAEU ordinary passports: 90 days in 180 visa-free
policies.summary: Cabinet Resolution No. 855 grants these EAEU citizens visa-free stay for a cumulative 90 days in each 180-day period.
conditions: The group is Armenia, Belarus, Kazakhstan and Russia, as named by the Cabinet regulation.
This is an ordinary-passport visitor normalization only; work, residence, registration, entry refusal, security and other document categories remain separate.

policies.title: Uzbekistan ordinary passports: 60 days in 120 visa-free
policies.summary: Cabinet Resolution No. 855 grants Uzbek citizens visa-free stay for a cumulative 60 days in each 120-day period.
conditions: The Cabinet rule applies unless an international treaty provides otherwise.
It does not decide work, residence, registration, special documents, security or individual admission.

policies.title: Serbia, Türkiye, Ukraine and Mongolia ordinary passports: 90 days in 180 visa-free
policies.summary: Cabinet Resolution No. 855 grants these four named nationalities visa-free stay for a cumulative 90 days in each 180-day period.
conditions: The Cabinet rule applies unless an international treaty provides otherwise.
It does not decide work, residence, registration, special documents, security or individual admission.

policies.title: Six Gulf ordinary passports: 180 days in 360 visa-free
policies.summary: Cabinet Resolution No. 855 grants these six named nationalities visa-free stay for a cumulative 180 days in each 360-day period.
conditions: The group is Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.
The Cabinet rule is subject to contrary international treaties in force and does not establish work, residence, registration, special-document, security or individual-admission rights.

policies.title: Other current government-listed ordinary passports: visa-free
policies.summary: The current Export Promotion and Investment Agency list expressly identifies these remaining nationalities as able to visit Kyrgyzstan without obtaining a visa.
conditions: This policy captures visa-free status only. The current government list does not print a stay duration for each name; do not infer a common duration or override applicable treaties.
It does not decide work, residence, registration, diplomatic/official/service/special-document treatment, transit, security or individual admission.

policies.title: Hong Kong and Macao permanent residents: 30-day visa-free
policies.summary: The current MFA eVisa information page expressly grants permanent residents of the Hong Kong and Macao SARs a 30-day visa-free regime for ordinary travel documents.
conditions: Requires permanent-resident status in the relevant SAR and applies to ordinary, service and diplomatic travel documents; this candidate only records the ordinary-passport baseline.
Stay is up to 30 days. It does not establish work, residence, registration, security or individual admission.

policies.title: Maldives ordinary passports: 30-day visa-free
policies.summary: The current MFA eVisa information page expressly grants Maldives citizens a 30-day visa-free regime for all travel-document types.
conditions: Stay is up to 30 days; the source says the regime covers all travel-document types, while this candidate records ordinary passports only.
It does not establish work, residence, registration, security or individual admission.
